info.title: Freya Bank voice assistant: statement and debt services
info.description: Built from the 1 Oct 2026 service contract (Mert Koç), sections 1-6, and test-environment/test-customers.md. It covers the seven services the voice assistant calls. The OAuth2 token endpoint is left out: the gateway sits in front of the services, the test environment does not check the token, and the phone agent does not call it as a bank service.

bearerAuth.description: Contract §2: 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on every service call. The token belongs to the integration (service account). The test environment does not check it.

Call.description: Contract §3: call metadata we log on our side. Nothing in this contract depends on it and the test environment ignores it.

CustomerNo.description: §5.1: 'customerNo may be sent as a string or as a number, both are accepted.'

rootCause.description: 'diagnostic strings; log them, don't branch on them'. Null on success.

guid.description: 'guid is our trace id; if you open a ticket with us, give us the guid.'

returnCode.description: 'Success = HTTP 200 and result.returnCode is "1". Anything else is an error.'

messageText.description: 'the messageText in errors is for logs, please don't read it out'

code.description: 'returnCode and code always carry the same value'

ErrorResponse.description: §4: 'Error answers have no data object, only result.'

x-conflicts: Card number masking: the service contract §5.1 and test-customers.md say cards.list returns first 6 + last 4 masked and production is unconfirmed. The 9 Oct decisions-recap e-mail (Selin/Elçin) says production returns the full number and masking is test-only. The 8 Oct analysis §2 says numbers come back masked. This spec follows the contract and test data.
cards.balance masking: the 2 Sep analysis §8 says first six and last four. The contract §5.2 and test data say first 4 + last 4 (5400********1234).

Statement-week limits: the IVR prompt sheet (STW-091/092) says once a month and at most three times a year. The cards FAQ (2025-08-14) says up to three times a year. Kerem in the 7 Oct transcript and the 8 Oct analysis §7 say once per calendar year. No service exposes an eligibility flag (contract §5.3, §7.3), and no error code for a refused change is documented in the contract.

E-mail address: the cards FAQ says statements can go to any address the customer gives. The 29 Sep kickoff e-mail Q3 and the 8 Oct analysis §6 say registered address only. The contract §5.7 says the backend does not check the address.

Due date and dates: the cards FAQ says the due date is about 10 days after the statement and moves to the next working day. The contract and test data give fixed dates from the service. The 10 Oct follow-up transcript says one test card (Yıldız Genç, ending 2020) has empty statementDate/lastPayDate, while the contract only documents dd.MM.yyyy strings.
Second factor: the call-flow PDF has a 'Second factor needed?' box. The kickoff e-mails (Q1), the 2 Sep analysis TBD and the 8 Oct analysis §2 say there is no second factor.

Silence: the 2 Sep analysis and Burcu's 28 Sep e-mail say main menu after the third silence. The 7 Oct transcript, the 9 Oct recap and the 8 Oct analysis §8.2 say end the call with 'Sesinizi alamadığım için görüşmeyi sonlandırıyorum.'
Angry caller: the 2 Sep analysis says one calming reply. The 9 Oct recap from Deniz says two. Selin's 9 Oct correction, the 7 Oct transcript and the 8 Oct analysis say three.

Out of scope: the 2 Sep and 8 Oct analyses (§7, §8.4) say go straight to the main menu. The 7 Oct transcript and the 9 Oct recap say first ask 'Sizi ana menüye aktarmamı ister misiniz?'. The 9 Oct e-mail says the 8 Oct document does not yet show the out-of-scope and card-number decisions.

Same last four digits: the 2 Sep analysis asks for the full card number. The 7 Oct transcript, the 8 Oct analysis §3.2 and the 9 Oct recap insert a last-six step first. The call-flow PDF shows only last 4 and last 6.

Currency wording: the IVR prompt sheet and the 2 Sep analysis tables use 'TL'/'USD' codes. The 7 Oct, 9 Oct and 10 Oct sources and the 8 Oct analysis §4.9 say full names (Türk Lirası, Dolar, Euro, İngiliz Sterlini). The IVR sheet has no Sterling prompt and plays no euro total.
Other-card question vs offer: in the 10 Oct test call the offer was made before the other-card question. The 7 Oct and 10 Oct decisions and the 8 Oct analysis §5.1 say ask about the other card first.
Cut-day reading: the 8 Oct analysis §4.10 says give the total debt. The 10 Oct transcript says open with the 00.00 cut sentence, then read totalDebt per currency, not statementDebt.

No-debt and missing currency: the 2 Sep analysis leaves it TBD whether a missing currency block goes into the no-debt sentence. The 8 Oct analysis §4.5 leaves it out. The contract says a missing block is not NO_DEBT.
Service timeout: the contract §4 and §7 and the analyses leave the timeout undefined. The test data includes a delaySeconds entry above ten seconds that still succeeds.
Error mapping: the contract §6 says services with no 404 answer an unknown record with a 400 INVALID_ARGUMENTS_ERROR in test, while their 404s are not documented in §4.
